=== .ci/config.yml (jobs-config)
# Imported from .ci/config.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: ci
on:
  push: {branches: ['*'], tags: [v1, v2]}
  schedule:
    - {cron: 0 2 * * *}
containers:
  main-test: {image: 'cimg/go:1.22'}
  main-test-db:
    image: cimg/postgres:16.0
    service: true
    env: {POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test}
  main-matrixed: {image: 'cimg/go:1.22'}
  main-matrixed-db:
    image: cimg/postgres:16.0
    service: true
    env: {POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test}
steps:
  main-build:
    image: cimg/go:1.22
    when: {branch: [main, develop], tag: [v1, v2]}
    env:
      GOFLAGS: -mod=readonly
      MODE: ci
      GOMODCACHE: .cache/go-mod
    run: |
      (
        cd app
        echo prep
      )
      # Build
      (
        cd app
        export CGO_ENABLED=0
        go build ./...
      )
    cache:
      - {name: cache-go-mod, paths: [.cache/go-mod], key: {files: ['**/go.sum']}}
    artifacts:
      - {name: bin, paths: [bin], when: always}
      - {name: workspace-main-build, paths: [bin]}
  main-test:
    container: main-test
    needs: main-build
    for_each:
      node-index: ["0", "1", "2"]
    env:
      CIRCLE_NODE_INDEX: {each: node-index}
      CIRCLE_NODE_TOTAL: "3"
    run: |
      go test ./...
    reports:
      tests: [reports/**/*.xml]
    fetch:
      - {from: main-build, name: workspace-main-build, into: .}
  main-hold-approval:
    kind: approval
    needs: main-test
    message: Run the jobs after hold?
  main-ship:
    image: cimg/base:stable
    needs: main-hold-approval
    run: |
      docker push registry.example.test/team/shop:$CIRCLE_SHA1
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: the step node/install ran here'; exit 1
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: a conditional block was here'; exit 1
      echo << parameters.target >>
  main-matrixed:
    container: main-matrixed
    for_each:
      node-index: ["0", "1", "2"]
    env:
      CIRCLE_NODE_INDEX: {each: node-index}
      CIRCLE_NODE_TOTAL: "3"
    run: |
      go test ./...
    reports:
      tests: [reports/**/*.xml]
  nightly-build:
    image: cimg/go:1.22
    env:
      GOFLAGS: -mod=readonly
      MODE: ci
      GOMODCACHE: .cache/go-mod
    run: |
      (
        cd app
        echo prep
      )
      # Build
      (
        cd app
        export CGO_ENABLED=0
        go build ./...
      )
    cache:
      - {name: cache-go-mod, paths: [.cache/go-mod], key: {files: ['**/go.sum']}}
    artifacts:
      - {name: bin, paths: [bin], when: always}
      - {name: workspace-nightly-build, paths: [bin]}
